PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-54628  Recommendation to approve March 5, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

2.  26-54629  Recommendation to receive and file the Bay-Delta Issues report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54630  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement UT-1544 with Partners for Public Good for Phase
  II of the Procurement Harmonization initiative, to increase the contract amount by
  $165,000, for a revised total amount not to exceed $240,000, and extend the term
  by six months.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54631  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. UD-26-306 and award a contract to
  Farwest Corrosion Control Company to furnish and deliver Corrosion Control and
  Cathodic Protection Supplies and Solutions for ongoing maintenance and support
  of the Long Beach Public Utilities Department’s natural gas pipelines in an annual
  amount not to exceed $200,000 for a period of one year, with the option to renew
  for two additional one-year periods, subject to a maximum annual increase of 5
  (five) percent, for a not-to-exceed amount of $210,000 for the first renewal period
  and a not-to-exceed amount of $220,500 for the second renewal period, and
  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 19, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54632  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to enter into a Schedule I,
  Transaction-Based Natural Gas Storage Service Agreement and any necessary
  amendments according to the long-term Master Services Contract with the
  Southern California Gas Company, for natural gas storage capacity rights in an
  amount not to exceed $1,891,578, for a period from April 1, 2026 to March 31,
  2027.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54633  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1548 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract and any necessary documents, including
  subsequent amendments, with the Institute of Gas Technology (GTI Energy), to
  conduct a study on decommissioning natural gas pipelines in the City of Long
  Beach and draft a report summarizing existing state laws governing the future
  planning of energy infrastructure in California, including natural gas pipeline
  infrastructure, in a total amount not to exceed $95,000, for a period of nine (9)
  months.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54634  Recommendation to receive and file March 5, 2026 Infrastructure Committee
  report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570- 6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
